top_signals.title: A Great Time To Diversify: Todd Sohn
top_signals.summary:
Todd Sohn, chief ETF strategist at Baird Strategas, joins Scarlet Fu and Eric Balchunas on “Bloomberg ETF IQ.” They discuss that Nvidia’s board reinstated Jensen Huang in one of the most startling corporate comebacks in history, sending the stock on its biggest rally in decades.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
